source.notes: A Creature (uninitialised, stats as in inventory/) whose Biota.PropertiesEmote is in.table (null for no table) and whose CurrentMotionState is in.motion ([stance, forward command], or null). Each table row is [category, probability, quest, vendor_type, wcid, style, substyle, min_health, max_health] (enums as ints, floats exact). in.health = [MaxHealth InitLevel, LevelFromCP, CurrentLevel, Endurance InitLevel]. in.query = [category, questName, vendorType, wcid, useRNG]. ThreadSafeRandom is new System.Random(in.seed). out = [index of the returned row in in.table or null, the next ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) (pins the draw count), Health.Percent].
